name: Hindustan Foods Limited
summary: Hindustan Foods Limited engages in the business of contract manufacturing of fast-moving consumer goods in India and internationally. The company offers breakfast cereals, instant porridges, rice crispies, instant mixes, soups and soup powders, spices and masala, sauces, dips, pastes, jams, jellies, preserves, gravies, cookies, protein and granola bars, chikkis, and muesli; and hot and cold beverages, and energy drink concentrates comprising carbonated soft drinks, ice cream, dessert, tea, coffee, malt-based food, glucose powder, and dry mix powder. It also provides hair oil, food, gel, cream, and shampoo; talc, shaving cream, hand wash liquid and powder, Eau De Toilette, and after shave lot…
